profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer specializing in modern C# development, distributed systems, and mission‑critical application design. I work across C#, .NET, Python, JavaScript, and C++ to build reliable, scalable software that performs in challenging environments. My background includes full‑stack development and earlier experience with PHP, HTML, CSS for web apps and some Java, giving me a broad foundation across multiple technology stacks.

I hold a B.S. in Computer Engineering from Old Dominion University and bring a practical, curiosity‑driven approach to engineering—whether building backend services, integrating complex systems, or working with hardware‑adjacent technologies. I’m passionate about solving hard problems, improving reliability, and delivering clean, maintainable solutions that support real‑world operations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer at Immersive Wisdom, I help build the resilient communications and collaborative operations software that enables military and government teams to work together even in the most challenging environments. Our platform supports distributed and disaggregated operations at ultra‑low bandwidth—down to 100 kbps per user—and continues running even when connections drop, giving mission‑critical teams the ability to collaborate across digital rooms using only standard laptops.

In my role, I design and develop full‑stack features across C#, .NET, JavaScript, and distributed system integrations. I build and maintain REST API connections with government systems, ensuring reliable data exchange across complex operational networks. I also contribute to the platform’s ability to integrate sensor feeds, geospatial data, enterprise applications, and real‑time video streams into synchronized collaborative environments used across the DoD.

I take ownership of features end‑to‑end from requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, CI/CD automation, deployment, and long‑term maintenance. My work includes debugging production issues across application, networking, and integration layers, improving development workflows through automation and AI‑assisted development, and collaborating directly with customers and engineering teams to deliver reliable, mission‑ready software.

Immersive Wisdom has recently achieved major milestones, including successful SATCOM interoperability tests at just 8 kbps, multiple consecutive renewals from U.S. Special Operations and PACAF, and contract awards such as the Missile Defense Agency SHIELD IDIQ—validating the impact and trust placed in our platform across the defense community.

I’m proud to contribute to a product that strengthens joint-force interoperability, supports operations in denied and degraded environments, and helps teams maintain situational awareness when it matters most.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked to help design and maintain their website and keep things up-to-date as well as adding in additional features and combining different APIs. Gained experience in PHP, Html, MySQL, Javascript, VB.net and Batch files by adding features to their website and creating useful internal software

positions.title: Broadcast Engineer Intern
positions.description: 11-week internship. Worked alongside Chief Engineer, Don Crowder, at FM99/The Fox radio studio to help transfer the radio transmitter from one radio tower to another while they replace their broadcast tower, all while learning how the transmission is received from the studio and then broadcast to your radio.  Also, worked alongside Head of IT, Peter Strome to learn about how the network works, set up a virtual hacking lab, and helped deal with the daily problems that come associated with controlling dozens of computers.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: 1 week program that allowed us to connect with Dahlgren employees and build a boat that would go out and circle around a buoy in the water, then come back without human intervention.

projects.title: Rocksat-C Monarch 4 ODU ECE Team
projects.description: For the Rocksat-C project, we were tasked with creating a payload that will measure radio signals and get telemetry data from the rocket while in-flight. My main role in the project was programming the Arduino and Raspberry Pi to communicate with each other and save data onto a flash drive for further analysis after the landing.
